title: Presbyterian College men's wrestling sets school record with 21 SoCon Honor Roll selections
text:
Presbyterian College men’s wrestling sets school record with 21 SoCon Honor Roll selections
The Presbyterian College men's wrestling program qualified 21 athletes to the Southern Conference (SoCon) Honor Roll, setting a new school record, according to a July 15 announcement from the college. Four of those athletes also met the requirements for Academic All-Conference.
This marks an increase from last year’s previous best of 20 Honor Roll selections. In total, Presbyterian College has collected 41 academic honorees over the past two seasons and has had 11 academic all-conference picks in that span.
The four student-athletes named to the SoCon Academic All-Conference team for the 2025-26 season are Fernando Dominguez, Reed Douglass, Ryan Luna, and Joshua Roe. Luna and Roe were recognized on this roster for the second consecutive year. For Dominguez and Douglass, it is their first time receiving this honor.
To qualify for Academic All-Conference recognition, student-athletes must maintain a cumulative grade point average of at least 3.3 and cannot be true freshmen or first-year transfers. They must also have competed in at least half of their team’s in-season events. The SoCon Honor Roll requires only a minimum GPA of 3.0 from the prior school year, without restrictions on class standing or playing time.
The full list of both Honor Roll and Academic All-Conference recipients was released by Presbyterian College.
